text.p: ING Barings in London rated Polish engineering firm Elektrobudowa SA as accumulate, saying it had a strong position in the rapidly growing power and chemical sectors, ING Barings said in its February 5 report.

"The company's competent development strategy and excellent track record, combined with a very efficient distribution network, have ensured high order backlogs, making it one of the most profitable engineering companies in Poland," it said.

It said its valuation at 14.2 times projected 1997 earnings appeared demanding but Ing Barings believed that the high quality of the firm should allow a 10-percent premium to the 1997 industrial P/E ratio.
"On the basis we expect a further 15 percent outperformance over the medium term and recommend buying the stock on weakness," it said.
ING Barings said the only major source of concern was rising labour costs due to growing wage demands.
On Monday Elektrobudowa traded at 63 zlotys.
ING Barings saw Elektrobudowa's net profit rising to 18.6 million zlotys in 1997 and to 23.9 million in 1998, up from last year's 13.9 million.
It said it expected the company's sales to grow to 271.3 million this year and to 340.3 million in 1998, up from last year's 217.5 million.
